title: single_instance tests wait with wall-clock recv_timeout
trigger: Run the single_instance tests (lines 749, 755, 785)
effect: AGENTS.md says tests use no timeouts or wall-clock waits; these tests use rx.recv_timeout(Duration::from_secs(5)) on real sockets, so a hang is a 5 s wait and a slow machine can flake
fix: Block on recv with the fake clock and heartbeat already in the file, or drive the owner through the Launched helper

title: UI-thread spelling menu blocks on the dictionary parse lock
trigger: Start Quill or change the spelling languages, then right-click a word in the composer before the warm-up thread has parsed a large dictionary
effect: checker.is_correct and checker.suggestions (ui/spellcheck_ui.rs:557,565) call Entry::dict, which waits on the Mutex<Load> held for the whole parse, so the window freezes for the parse time (seconds for the big European dictionaries); the module doc says the UI thread never blocks on the parse
fix: Make the UI-thread path try_lock the Load and treat a parse in progress as a new Load::Parsing stage that answers no verdict or no suggestions

title: Download stage is a raw AtomicU8 with RUNNING/CANCELLING/FINISHED constants beside received and the UI's DictDownload
trigger: ui/spell_dictionaries.rs starts a download: DictDownload::Running holds the Progress, whose stage the worker and the UI poll loop read
effect: The stage is a number, not an enum, and is_cancelled turns false once FINISHED, so the UI cannot tell a cancelled finish from a completed one except by the DownloadError it awaits; the stage is mirrored by DictDownload and RowDownload
fix: A #[repr(u8)] enum DownloadStage with TryFrom<u8>, loaded through one accessor, or a channel carrying Cancelled/Finished

title: Timed-out spelling jobs stay queued on the COM thread and the UI thread waits up to 750 ms per call
trigger: Windows: open the suggestion menu repeatedly while the COM thread loads a cold dictionary or is stuck
effect: Each suggestions call blocks the UI up to CALL_WAIT, and every abandoned job still runs later on an unbounded channel, so a backlog builds and later answers are late
fix: Drop a job whose answer channel is gone before running it, and carry a generation or cancel token in Job

title: StoryComposer::open bool beside an always-present Box<StoryComposer> and its stage
trigger: Open the story composer, press Post (stage Posting), close the composer, reopen it
effect: No bug today (close() replaces the whole value, and answers are matched by RequestId), but 'open' is an Option-as-flag: a closed composer still carries a live-looking stage, media and mode, and every reader must test open first (esc_stack, render, click-through)
fix: StoryUi::composer: Option<Box<StoryComposer>> (or a Composer { Closed, Open(StoryComposer) } enum) so closed has no stage

title: Composer link_url / reaction_emojis mirror TextareaState inputs synced by hand before posting; mode and as_chat_id are separate bare-id fields
trigger: Edit the link or emoji field then post/save; or open Edit/Repost with as_chat_id set from a previous poster
effect: Two copies of the same text (struct string and input entity) must be copied in step; ComposerMode::Repost/Edit(i64,i32) and as_chat_id: Option<i64> are bare chat ids that must agree with each other and the account
fix: read the text from the inputs at send time only (drop the mirrors); fold as_chat_id into ComposerMode with OfAccount/ChatId owner keys

title: CloseFriendsStage::Loading/Failed carry no RequestId and shadow CloseFriendsList::Loading/Failed in the session
trigger: Open the close-friends editor, let getCloseFriends fail, press Retry; or open it while another load is in flight
effect: No bug today, but the load stage lives twice (viewer panel stage and Session::stories::close_friends). The panel stage leaves Loading only when the UI tick reads failed_without_list() or a list from the session, instead of by the answer to its own request; with no live driver (demo) Loading has no way out but Cancel
fix: derive the panel's Loading/Failed from CloseFriendsList (single owner), keeping only Editing/Saving{request} in the panel stage

title: StoryPageOp keyed by bare Option<i64> chat id and a free-text label; finished ops linger until a caller settles them by hand
trigger: Run an album mutation, leave the page without the owner calling settle_story_page_op/leave_story_page; or have more than 64 ops in flight
effect: Succeeded/Failed ops stay in the list until settle_finished/forget_chat is called from outside their own transitions; loading() matches reads by label string; begin() past the cap with no finished op grows the Vec without bound
fix: op identity = RequestId + typed StoryPageOpKind (not a label string), owner ChatId; finished ops expire in their own transition (Succeeded/Failed with a deadline) instead of caller-driven settle

title: One-shot notes and balance_low queues are drained from render (status_toast_visible) with no lock or owner check
trigger: Approve/decline/offer fails (or BALANCE_TOO_LOW) while the app is locked or the account is not the live one, then unlock or switch back
effect: The error toast (and the top-up box from ask_after_balance_error) appears late or while locked; the Vec has no cap if nothing drains it; the draining is a state mutation inside a render path
fix: push the failure into the window/account notice queue at the error arm (owner-scoped, refused_while_locked), no Vec the render drains

title: AccentRead::Failed is final: a read that found no accent (portal says no preference, or gdbus not ready at startup) is never retried
trigger: Linux: start Quill while the desktop has no accent or the session bus is not up yet, then set an accent in system settings and open Appearance
effect: The 'use system accent' option stays hidden/unavailable until restart; refresh() returns at the Idle check so the new accent is never read
fix: Failed{last, retry_after} (or back to Idle after the failed read) so a later refresh() from a settings open or window focus can read again

title: ToneUpload::Uploading holds no RequestId: the answer is matched by purpose and nothing ends it if the answer never comes
trigger: Start Upload Sound, connection or TDLib client drops the request without an answer
effect: finish_tone_upload and apply_tone_upload_error act on RequestPurpose::UploadSavedNotificationSound only (Added{target:None} exists for 'not Uploading'); upload_notification_tone refuses while Uploading, so uploads are blocked and the footer spinner stays until the account session is rebuilt. Also a new upload may overwrite an unconsumed Added/Failed outcome
fix: Uploading{request,..}; settle only the matching request; clear to Failed on session reset

title: baseline: TopPerson::saved_messages
trigger: Search strip lists Saved Messages tile
effect: Tile for the Saved Messages chat is built (bool fact in the baseline; no bug today)
fix: TopPersonKind { SavedMessages, Chat } or drop it and ask session.is_saved_messages(chat_id)

title: Tray publisher's stopped flag is set only when its loop ends normally
trigger: The tray update worker panics (caught by spawn_guarded) or cannot be spawned
effect: done.store(true) comes after the loop inside the guarded closure, so a panic or spawn failure leaves stopped=false forever: poll() never restarts the item, and the unread badge/toggles freeze until the watcher closes or Quill restarts
fix: Set stopped from a drop guard in the worker closure, and set it when spawn_guarded fails

title: Crop::mirrored subtracts x and w from 1000 unchecked on public u16 fields
trigger: A Crop whose x + w exceeds 1000 reaches mirrored() before clamped()
effect: Debug build panics on overflow; release wraps to a garbage x that clamped() then moves
fix: Use saturating_sub (as turned_cw does) or clamp first

title: A capture's paused stage lives in three places kept in step by hand
trigger: None today; pause()/resume() change them together
effect: VoiceCapture.clock (RunClock.since), Live.control (Handshake) and the mic stream's own pause/play are each moved by pause() and resume(); preview_path reads two of them, so a miss shows the wrong control or no preview. pause() calls clock.pause_at, control.ask_pause, mic.pause; resume() the reverse
fix: One Recording/Paused stage on Source::Live that owns the clock, the handshake and the mic

title: Action keeps one write's outcome as three bools (ok, declined, undone) that must agree
trigger: An agent write is refused by the user (declined=true must come with ok=false, set by hand at agent/ui_driver/guard.rs and tools/write/common.rs), or the user presses Undo on an entry (undone is only meaningful when ok)
effect: No bug today. A new writer that sets declined without clearing ok, or Undo on a failed or declined entry, shows a wrong or contradictory log row
fix: enum Outcome { Done, Failed, Declined, Undone } on Action (serde-compatible with the old three fields)

title: FOLDERS entries per TDLib client id are never removed when the client closes
trigger: Log out or remove accounts repeatedly in one run
effect: One folder list per dead client id stays in memory for the process life; folders(client_id) of a dead client still answers
fix: Drop the entry from the same client_closed path that ends td waiters

title: The new-message buffer keeps up to 256 raw messages of every chat (granted or not) after the last agent disconnects, after lock and after log-out
trigger: An agent connects, messages arrive in non-granted chats, agent disconnects, user locks Quill or logs out
effect: Message bodies stay in process memory until 256 newer ones displace them; readers filter by client id and grants so nothing is served, but the content outlives its owner
fix: Clear MESSAGES/OUTCOMES when connected_agents() drops to 0, on lock and on client_closed

title: Test waits on the wall clock: thread::sleep(50ms) and a 5 s wait_for timeout
trigger: Run the test suite
effect: Non-deterministic test, against the rule 'no sleeps, timeouts or wall-clock waits in tests'
fix: Start the waiter, poll a barrier/channel for 'waiting', then record; or test the pure filter step with a manual clock

title: for_account reads CACHE with read() and treats a poisoned lock as 'no cache', reloading from disk
trigger: A thread panics while holding the CACHE write lock after a narrowing whose save failed
effect: Reads fall back to the file, which still holds the access the user took back, so agents get it again; every other site uses read_or_recover
fix: Use read_or_recover/write_or_recover in for_account like change_all_saving does

title: Pending::conn is a u64 where 0 means 'no connection'
trigger: A prompt filed from a thread with no call scope gets conn 0; withdraw_connection(0) is special-cased to do nothing
effect: No bug today; a prompt with conn 0 can never be withdrawn by a connection ending
fix: Option<ConnId> (None for no connection) so withdraw_connection cannot be called with the sentinel

title: Test uses a real 10 ms recv_timeout to exercise the timeout withdrawal path
trigger: Run the test suite
effect: Wall-clock wait in a test (a_prompt_waits_for_the_user_and_withdraws_on_timeout)
fix: Pass Duration::ZERO or inject the timeout so no real time passes

title: Skip 01-024 does not hold: Revoke is keyed on the client's self-declared name, so a revoked agent reconnects under another name
trigger: Press Revoke for 'Claude Code' in Agent access; the agent reconnects with params.client 'Claude Code 2' and the same launch token
effect: The revoked agent is let back in (refused(&agent) compares only the name); the skip reason ('a design of its own') is effort
fix: Per-client identity (token per client written by connect) or revoke by token, as the skip says

title: live_inputs builds Takeover from three separate lock acquisitions (stopped(), paused(), current())
trigger: Press Stop or take control while quill_status or the Agent access page builds its summary
effect: Summary can show a window state that never existed (e.g. Driving while Paused), until the next render
fix: One takeover::snapshot() returning the single Hold/Phase value read under one lock

title: CLIENTS keeps a closed account's Client (Arc<TdJson>, Arc<TdHub>) until some account registers again
trigger: Log out or remove an account and register no other client
effect: The dead client's api/hub handles stay alive; client_for ignores it so no wrong answer, only retained resources
fix: Remove the entry in client_closed(client_id) next to the PENDING wake-up

title: list_chats and list_unread look at only the first 200 chats of a list and report no truncation
trigger: Account with a granted chat that is below the 200th entry of the main list; call list_chats or list_unread
effect: The granted chat (and its unread) never appears and the answer says 'No granted chats here' or lists fewer, with no cursor to continue
fix: Page getChats until the limit is filled or the list ends, or return a 'more' cursor

title: KNOWN cache (me and chat classes) is keyed by TDLib client id and never pruned when the client or account goes away
trigger: Add, log out and re-add accounts over a long session; each new client gets a fresh id and its entries stay
effect: Small unbounded growth of Known::me; Known::classes only resets at 20,000 entries; nothing wrong is shown
fix: hold the cache in the per-client state the hub drops on client close, or prune on route close
